central_boundary.build: Go 1.26 Alpine; CGO_ENABLED=0; go build ./cmd/server/; linux/amd64 + linux/arm64
central_boundary.change: Only workflow source SHA changes; Dockerfile and build parameters unchanged.

coverage.method: Both full trees untruncated; every non-test blob fetched by Git blob SHA and re-hashed; import-only hunks separated mechanically with the complete import delta recorded; substantive diff screened in full for new hosts, HTTP clients/dialers, process/syscall, env reads, file writes, embeds, linkname, encoded payloads; network/credential/file/plugin chains read in full.
coverage.non_go: Embedded models.json/codex_client_models.json: model metadata only, no new hosts. config.example.yaml comments/defaults. README/AGENTS/assets/examples outside central build.

semantic_findings: Import delta: encoding/json→moego/json (189 files), regexp→moego/regexp (26); drop-in replacements, no behaviour-bearing call added in those hunks.

New /muse-code/{models,config,search,browser_open} behind existing AuthMiddleware; /models generated locally, the others relay to the selected Meta credential origin (base_url or default https://api.meta.ai) with request/response header allowlists, key/auth_token stripped from query, 16MiB limits; uses existing auth manager HTTP path and result marking.
delegatedInterceptorHost: embedder-provided interceptor host wiring; plugin dispatch stays on existing plugin host. Scheduler continuity/exclude-candidates plugin callbacks: in-process, panic-fused.

Management auth upload: atomic temp-file write (0600) in auth dir, reconcile/unregister removed sources, persistence through existing operator-configured token stores; management secret bcrypt verification cache keyed by random-HMAC digest, 1h TTL, 64 entries.
SIWC bind honours per-credential proxy_url after validation; Antigravity TOS appeal URL logged with query/fragment redacted.
Request capture: local error diagnostics bounded (32) and sanitized for logs only.
Cloak sensitive-patterns-replace: operator-configured regex replacement in prompts; invalid patterns skipped.
No new upstream hostnames, HTTP clients, exec/syscall, env reads, go:embed or linkname in the substantive increment.
